docs.summary: Represents a scroll wheel event on an element. Delta is the scroll amount and direction (positive = down/right, negative = up/left, in arbitrary units).
Gets the scroll delta, in logical units. Positive values indicate scrolling down or right; negative values indicate up or left, depending on the scroll direction.

Horizontal scroll from a tilting wheel or a trackpad. Positive scrolls toward the start (left), like a positive [`Delta`](#api~Prowl.PaperUI.Events.ScrollEvent~Delta) scrolls up. Zero for a plain vertical wheel.
